info.title: Utility Optimizer CRM API
info.description: REST API for the Utility Optimizer CRM. Authenticate with POST /api/auth/login (session cookie). State-changing requests must send the X-CSRF-Token header with the token returned by login or /api/auth/me. Errors use { statusCode, message, issues? }; 422 means a business rule was not met.
